localStorage.pluginOffline: Vite file storage plugin NOT mounted
localStorage.pluginOfflineHint: Check that filesStoragePlugin() is registered in vite.config.ts, or set FILES_DIR env to specify the save directory.
localStorage.serverRootHint: Determined by Vite plugin config / FILES_DIR env var. Restart Vite dev server to change.
localStorage.apiBaseHint: Prefix for the upload/delete/list APIs provided by the Vite plugin.
localStorage.publicPathHint: Saved files are accessible via this path, e.g. /files/images/abc.png.
localStorage.whyHint:
Why local save?
External image URLs (e.g. OSS signed links) are typically blocked by browser CORS, so they cannot be fetched into a Blob. This adapter POSTs generated image/audio/video Blobs to the local Vite server, which writes them to disk — no external API call needed.

mediaCache.title: Media Cache (Service Worker)
mediaCache.swOnline: Service Worker active — cross-origin media auto-cached
mediaCache.swOffline: Service Worker not active (cannot cache cross-origin media)
mediaCache.swOfflineHint: Possible causes: SW not supported, page not served over HTTPS / localhost, or sw.js registration failed.
mediaCache.howItWorks: How it works: • Cross-origin image URLs (e.g. OSS signed links) are auto-cached to CacheStorage when first loaded via . • When the user clicks "Save", the main thread reads bytes from CacheStorage (bypassing CORS), then writes to local disk. • 0 network requests on second save. • Up to 200 entries (LRU eviction).
